clip_black.tooltip: Matte values at or below this become 0 (cleans a noisy background).

clip_white.tooltip: Matte values at or above this become 1 (solidifies the core).

clip_rollback_px.tooltip: Restore the unclipped matte within this many pixels of the clipped edge, bringing back hair and motion blur that clipping removed.

despeckle_px.tooltip: Remove isolated foreground specks smaller than this area (pixels). 0 = off.

fill_holes_px.tooltip: Fill holes inside the subject smaller than this area (pixels). 0 = off.

despeckle_level.tooltip: Matte level separating specks (above it) and holes (below 1 - it) from their surroundings. Low keeps hair attached to the subject; raise on noisy mattes, where haze joins specks to the subject or core noise joins holes together. 0.5 = classic hard threshold.

choke_px.tooltip: Shrink (-) or grow (+) the matte edge by this many pixels.

soften_px.tooltip: Blur the matte edge (Gaussian, sigma = soften_px / 2).

temporal_smoothing.tooltip: Reduce flicker by averaging each pixel with its neighbor frames, only where the matte changes little, so moving edges do not ghost. 1 = about 3 frames each way.

garbage_matte.tooltip: White = always background. 1 mask for the whole clip or one per frame; resized to the matte.

holdout_matte.tooltip: White = always subject (core matte). 1 mask or one per frame; resized to the matte.

CorridorKey2MatteRefine.name: CorridorKey2MatteRefine
CorridorKey2MatteRefine.description: Cleans up a matte. Steps run in this order: clip levels, despeckle / fill holes, choke, soften, temporal smoothing, garbage matte, holdout matte. Every step is off at its default.
